images.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Restyle the supplied context diagram as a sophisticated editorial PHOTO CUT-PAPER COLLAGE matching the second reference (MCP collage). Bold crisp Archivo-like text on torn cream paper labels. No robot, faces, cartoons, neon, glossy 3D, watermark. Preserve the information structure of FIRST reference. A large front-facing upright rectangular teal context board is the main subject. Add a small grayscale photographic laptop and RAM-module collage in the lower LEFT outside the context board, on a teal and red paper scrap with sparse halftone, visually subordinate to the board. This photo cluster is a metaphor, not part of the context contents. Large readable diagram, abundant margins. Landscape 3:2. Title label "Context window" above the board. The context board must have an outlined warm ivory interior which is COMPLETELY EMPTY, with a thick teal paper frame. No message papers inside; preserve the finite fixed rectangular boundary. Keep all photographic objects OUTSIDE the empty context rectangle. A single empty rectangle is the information.

images.name: focused-context
images.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Restyle the FIRST reference context zone diagram as editorial PHOTO CUT-PAPER COLLAGE matching the SECOND reference MCP collage. Landscape 3:2. Warm ivory #EFEAE0 background, torn paper labels, grayscale photographic laptop and RAM-module cutouts with cream edges in a SMALL lower-left cluster OUTSIDE the board, muted teal backing scraps, vermilion accents, sparse black halftone and shallow paper shadows. Main subject is one large upright context rectangle, with title on cream torn paper above "Context window". Preserve its EXACT simple information: one continuous rectangle split into a teal upper field labeled "Smart zone" and a red lower field labeled "Dumb zone", approximate proportions 65 percent upper and 35 percent lower. Thin crisp black outer border and horizontal divider. Labels large bold crisp Archivo-like sans-serif on cream paper strips within each field. Both colored fields contiguous and rectangular, no messages or icons within them. Caption below on cream torn label "Conceptual zones — no fixed threshold". Preserve this caveat clearly. Photo cutouts small and outside the rectangle, do not imply a physical capacity measurement. Fine paper grain, tactile edges, print editorial style. No added numbers, thresholds, arrows, robots, logos, watermark.

images.name: capacity-and-recall
images.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Restyle FIRST reference benchmark chart with a restrained editorial collage FRAME matching SECOND reference MCP collage. Preserve the actual chart EXACTLY as a precise quantitative line graph, without any decorative elements in its plotting area. Landscape 2:1. Warm ivory paper, title on one torn cream paper strip, a small grayscale RAM-module photographic cutout with cream edge and sparse halftone in the unused TOP LEFT MARGIN only, tiny teal and red torn backing paper behind title. Keep chart enormous and legible. No tilt or perspective on the graph. All axes, grid lines, points and straight connecting segments must remain mathematically precise. Exactly eight equally spaced categorical x buckets: 4–8K, 8–16K, 16–32K, 32–64K, 64–128K, 128–256K, 256–512K, 512K–1M. Data values respectively 97.5%, 93%, 95%, 90%, 86%, 79.5%, 57.5%, 36%. Place every point at its correct vertical value on a LINEAR y-axis with ticks 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100% at equal spacing. Label every point with its exact percentage, first SIX teal and final TWO vermilion. Preserve slight upturn at third point. Very pale red translucent highlight behind last two buckets. Y axis "Accuracy". X axis "Context window range (tokens)". Title "GPT-5.4 · MRCR v2, 8-needle". Bold crisp Archivo-like typography, all labels intact. No collage objects over any axis, labels, lines or points. Editorial collage feeling only in margins and title paper, plus fine grain. No extra words, values, icons, logos or watermark.
